note: Resampling pressure case: hidden_0.85, N=256, forbidden/counting/dyck; fixed 1/step (exact) and lex B=0.03 +pull; product vs chain twist; resampling off/defensive/plain. K=16: 50 runs; K=64: 12 runs. The two resampling-off arms are the same sampler with different seeds (replicates). spread = sd/mean of Z_hat (unreliable where flagged). log_ratio_rows: statistics over runs of log(Z_hat / p(C)); for an unbiased Z_hat the mean is at most 0; closer to 0 and smaller sd/RMS is better.
